cd /app && cat > /app/render_test.py <<'EOF'
import bpy, os, sys
os.makedirs("/app/test", exist_ok=True)
bpy.ops.wm.open_mainfile(filepath='/app/result.blend')
scene = bpy.context.scene
scene.eevee.taa_render_samples = 16
frames = [1, 91, 166, 196, 226, 271, 316, 420]
for fr in frames:
    scene.frame_set(fr)
    scene.render.filepath = "/app/test/r_%03d.png" % fr
    bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
print("RENDER DONE")
EOF
blender_run --python /app/render_test.py 2>&1 | grep -E "RENDER DONE|Error"
